           ONISCUS ASELLUS

         Wood-louse

        (MILLEPEDES)


Has distinct diuretic properties; hence its use in dropsies. Asthmatic
        conditions, with bronchial catarrh.



Head.--  Boring pain behind right ear in mastoid process (  Caps  ). Violent pulsation of arteries (  Pothos;
        Glonoine  ). Painful pressure above the root of nose.



Stomach.--  Persistent pressure in cardiac orifice. Vomiting.



Abdomen.--  Distended;   meteorism; very
        severe colic  .



Urine.--  Cutting, burning in urethra.   Tenesmus
        of bladder and rectum  , with absence of stool and urine.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Pothos foet;
        Canth  .



Dose.--  Sixth potency.
